title: Can You Score 80% On This Treatments Quiz?
summary: Recognize the names, connect the clues and separate familiar treatments from common mix-ups. Can you reach 80%?

landing.intro:
Know your treatments?
Put your knowledge to the test.

about.body:
Recognize treatment names, explore how they work and connect the clues in short scenarios. Each round brings a new topic and feedback on your answers. Your overall score and topic breakdown appear at the end.

Choose one answer for each question. Speed never changes your score. A short rewarded ad opens the quiz, and another is offered at each round checkpoint to continue or reveal your result. The optional answer review has its own rewarded ad. Progress is saved on this device.

Questions explore general treatment concepts. They describe what treatments are, rather than choosing care for an individual. Familiar names do not establish effectiveness or suitability. Facts were checked against public health and medical references.

steps: Tap Start to begin after a short rewarded ad.
Choose the best answer, then continue to a new treatment topic at each checkpoint.
Reveal your score and optionally unlock a review of the answers you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not medical advice, a clinical assessment or a healthcare qualification. Ask a qualified healthcare professional about treatment decisions.
